results.name: Flood in  Albania and Montenegro
results.reason: Referring to the situation of severe weather in the territory of the Republic of Albania and Montenegro since the 06 of January 2026, ERCC activated CEMS RM on behalf of the National Civil Protection Agency of Albania to assess the areas covered by water. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide Flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
